reviews.title: Love the colorful, simple interface. Missing a few key functionalities.
reviews.text:
I’ve used a few habit tracking apps and this is my favorite interface that I’ve seen. I love that it’s clean, colorful and easy to read. Great work! 

Would love to keep using it but definitely missing a few functions that I’ve seen in other apps that would be useful:
- Being able to check off a habit multiple times in one day (for instance, for medicine that needs to be taken morning and night)
- Being able to duplicate already created habits so as not to have to set all parameters from scratch 
- Being able to click through the calendar to see habit/task lists on different days
- Being able to sort habits by time of day (morning vs evening for example)
- Being able to set the time increment to “weeks” or “months” for habits. Currently, everything is by days so a weekly habit must be set to every “7 days”, which isn’t totally intuitive.

reviews.title: Another Broken Habit Tracker
reviews.text:
I downloaded this after InnerGrow’s Habit Tracker app failed to accurately keep track of my completed habits. Onrise was free and had good privacy features, so I gave it a try. I used Onrise for two months and it was great. Then they released their monthly At a Glance feature. I completed all my habits for January, but according to this new feature I completed only 30 of 31 days. What’s the point of using a habit tracker app if it can’t even do the thing it supposed to do?

Reply to developer: Maybe I missed a day? I started using the app on December 8 and completed all goals. I also completed all goals for January, and the first day of February (the day I stopped using it). Your app said I had a 56-day streak (24 + 31 + 1). I wouldn’t have a 56-day streak if I missed a day, would I? Maybe you just missed a line in the code?

reviews.title: Soooo great!
reviews.text:
This app is so great! I love how simple, easy to use, and nice looking it is!
The one thing I would suggest is to look at the UI of the app "Atoms." and read Atomic Habits by james clear and try to implement some of the tips from that book in the app, like habit stacking.

Also regarding "Atoms." I think your UI could really really benefit from a satisfying animation when you click off a habit like in Atoms so its satisfying when you complete a habit. 

Also, I think it would be more helpful to see each habit in a list per-DAY instead of per-WEEK, and rhen have a weekly view of habits and if youve completed/failed throughout the week, instead of having that on the main habit checklist menu. That way #1 its easier to make it satisfying to complete the habit cause it can take up the whole card/screen, and #2 it makes it nicer for users cause you can see just that day instead of worrying about the whole week!
